title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Everything you need to know about getting started.

faqs.q: Do we need any prior Bitcoin knowledge?
faqs.a: No. Our sessions are designed for beginners and for people who want a simpler, clearer understanding of Bitcoin without feeling overwhelmed.
No. BitcoinStart Nordics focuses on education, onboarding, and practical guidance. We do not provide financial, tax, or investment advice.

faqs.q: What do we actually help with?
faqs.a: We help with understanding Bitcoin, getting started in a practical way, learning the basics of wallets and security, and avoiding common beginner mistakes.

faqs.q: Do we help with wallet setup?
faqs.a: Yes. Our Wallet & Security Setup session is designed for people who want practical guidance around wallet options, backup thinking, and safer Bitcoin habits.

faqs.q: Can complete beginners book a session?
faqs.a: Yes. In fact, that is exactly who most of our sessions are designed for.

faqs.q: Do we need to already own Bitcoin?
faqs.a: No. Many people book a session before taking any action, simply to understand Bitcoin better and get clarity on the right next steps.

faqs.q: Do we work with small businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer practical Bitcoin workshops and guidance for small businesses that want to understand whether Bitcoin is relevant for them.

faqs.q: Which languages do we offer sessions in?
faqs.a: We currently offer sessions in English and Swedish.

faqs.q: Are sessions online or in person?
faqs.a: Sessions are currently available online, making it easy for clients across the Nordics to book.
Once a session is booked, we send a confirmation with the meeting link and any relevant information needed before the session.

faqs.q: What will we leave with after a session?
faqs.a: You will leave with more clarity, a better understanding of Bitcoin, and practical next steps based on where you are today.

faqs.q: Can we ask questions during the session?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Sessions are meant to be practical, interactive, and tailored to your level and needs.
